theorems.statement: For explicit positive-rational branch moment matrices W^(m), let mu be the maximum cycle geometric mean of the entrywise dominant-weight graph and let K_ij be the dominant tie multiplicity d_ij on edges belonging to the tropical critical graph, zero elsewhere. Then mu^(-mn) det(mu^m t I-W^(m)) converges coefficientwise to det(tI-K), and rho(W^(m))/mu^m converges to rho(K).
theorems.log_readout: ln rho(W^(m)) = m ln mu + ln rho(K) + o(1).
theorems.root_free_certificate: Critical/subcritical cycles are classified by rational power equalities/inequalities against any reference critical cycle; no root evaluation is required for the certificate.

theorems.statement: For every strict characteristic exponential base b occupying k cycle-system vertices relative to reference critical cycle (r0,Q0), eta_b=b^r0/Q0^k lies in (0,1). With eta=max eta_b, normalized characteristic coefficient errors are O(eta^(m/r0)); on multiples m=r0*s the checker verifies explicit integer-coefficient bounds C_k eta^s. If rho(K) is a simple limiting Perron root, ordinary root perturbation yields rho(W^(m))/mu^m=rho(K)+O(eta^(m/r0)).
theorems.special_cases: A unique critical r-cycle with edge tie product D has rho(K)=D^(1/r). Critical route branching can give rho(K)>1 even when every critical edge tie multiplicity is one.

theorems.statement: For the non-negative integer critical-degeneracy matrix K, p_K(z)=det(I-zK) is an exact integer polynomial and its smallest positive root z_c equals 1/rho(K). The exact critical log correction is Gamma_crit=-ln z_c. The correction state is represented by p_K plus the SMALLEST_POSITIVE_REAL_ROOT selector and either an exact rational root or a rational Sturm isolating interval.
theorems.rational_root_rule: Because p_K(0)=1, every positive rational root is 1/q for an integer divisor q of the absolute leading coefficient; rational roots can be extracted before Sturm isolation of the remaining irrational roots.

theorems.statement: Gamma_crit>=0. For a critical-graph matrix K, Gamma_crit=0 iff every nonzero critical SCC is a unit-multiplicity directed simple cycle. For rational R>0, Gamma_crit<ln R iff K/R is in the exact stable finite-recurrent phase. If z_c lies in a rational interval a<z_c<b with a>0, then ln(1/b)<Gamma_crit<ln(1/a), so existing rational BRC LN supplies arbitrarily refinable bounds without a general algebraic-log evaluator.
theorems.specializations: If z_c=a/b is rational, Gamma_crit=ln(b/a). For a unique critical r-cycle with degeneracy product D, Gamma_crit=(1/r)ln D. K=[[1,1],[1,0]] gives the genuinely irrational correction ln(phi).

negative_boundaries.statement: One selected critical cycle's degeneracy product D is not a complete multi-critical correction. The general subleading object is rho(K), which includes competing critical classes and critical route branching.

Floating eigenvalue/root computation is not an Enterprise proof certificate for the critical correction. Exact state uses rational cycle comparisons, integer K, integer criticality polynomial and exact root selection/isolation.
rho(K) and z_c need not be rational. For K=[[1,1],[1,0]], p_K=1-z-z^2 and rho(K) is the golden ratio. Arbitrary critical corrections cannot be forced into the rational LN runtime.

Aggregated total-mass matrices do not in general retain dominant branch tie multiplicities needed to reconstruct K. Critical-degeneracy analysis requires explicit positive-rational branch/histogram data.
